import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)


def clean_comment(text):
    """Clean and standardize comment text."""
    if pd.isna(text) or str(text).strip() == "":
        return ""
    try:
        text = str(text)
        # Remove escape sequences
        text = text.replace('\\"', '"')
        text = text.strip().replace('"', "")
        text = text.lower()
        # Normalize whitespace and newlines
        text = " ".join(text.split())
        return text
    except Exception:
        return ""


def main():
    # Define paths - based on Data Overview, files are under input/
    train_path = "input/train.csv"
    test_path = "input/test.csv"
    sample_sub_path = "input/sample_submission_null.csv"
    submission_path = "submission/submission.csv"

    # Load all data
    train_data = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_data = pd.read_csv(test_path)

    # Get column names from actual data
    comment_col_train = "Comment"
    comment_col_test = "Comment"
    label_col = "Insult"

    # Process training data
    train_cleaned = train_data[comment_col_train].apply(clean_comment).tolist()

    # Process test data
    test_cleaned = test_data[comment_col_test].apply(clean_comment).tolist()

    # Extract labels and features
    y_train = train_data[label_col].values.astype(int)
    X_train_str = train_cleaned
    X_test_str = test_cleaned

    # Convert string lists to numpy arrays for TF-IDF
    X_train_arr = np.array(X_train_str, dtype=object)
    X_test_arr = np.array(X_test_str, dtype=object)

    # Fit TF-IDF vectorizer on training data only (features only, no labels needed)
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        max_features=50000,
        stop_words="english",
        lowercase=True,
    )

    # Fit transform entire training data, then split for validation
    X_train_full_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_arr)

    # Stratified train/validation split (no refitting on held-out data)
    X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_full_vec, y_train, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Train LightGBM on training portion ONLY (never see validation data)
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=500,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        min_child_samples=20,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        force_row_wise=True,
        boosting_type="gbdt",
    )
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

    # Validate on truly held-out data (model was NOT trained on these rows)
    val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

    if len(np.unique(y_val)) > 1:
        try:
            val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_proba)
            print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error computing validation AUC: {e}")
            val_auc = 0.5
    else:
        print("WARNING: Validation set has insufficient positive/negative samples")
        val_auc = 0.5

    # Final predictions on complete test set (no labels to learn from)
    test_proba = model.predict_proba(vectorizer.transform(X_test_arr))[:, 1]

    # Load sample submission for format compliance
    sub_df = None
    pred_col_name = "Prediction"
    try:
        if os.path.exists(sample_sub_path):
            sample_df = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)
            sub_df = sample_df.copy()
            # Find prediction column
            for col in sub_df.columns:
                if (
                    "prediction" in col.lower()
                    or "score" in col.lower()
                    or "proba" in col.lower()
                ):
                    pred_col_name = col
                    break
            if sub_df.empty:
                pred_col_name = "Prediction"
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Warning: Could not load sample submission: {e}")
        if sub_df is None:
            sub_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["Prediction"])

    # Create submission with same structure as sample (if exists) or default
    if sub_df is not None and not sub_df.empty:
        # Ensure same number of rows as test predictions
        n_rows = len(sub_df)
        if len(test_proba) != n_rows:
            n_rows = len(test_proba)

        result_indices = (
            sub_df.head(n_rows).index.values[:n_rows]
            if len(result_indices) >= n_rows
            else []
        )
        # Build dataframe matching sample structure
        sub_final = sub_df.iloc[: min(len(sub_df), n_rows)].copy()
    else:
        sub_final = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=(
                ["Prediction"] * len(sub_df.columns)
                if isinstance(pred_col_name, str)
                else ["Prediction"]
            )
        )

    # Fill in predictions
    for i in range(min(len(test_proba), len(sub_final))):
        sub_final.loc[i, pred_col_name] = (
            f"{test_proba[i]:.6f}"
            if pred_col_name in sub_final.columns
            else f"{test_proba[i]:.6f}"
        )

    # Save final submission to correct location
    sub_final.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
    print(f"Submission file saved to {submission_path}")
    print(f"Total predictions: {len(test_proba)}")

    print(f"\nFinal Model Evaluation:")
    print(f"AUC-ROC on Hold-Out Validation Set: {val_auc:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
